subject: Business Models
title: Anchoring with Annual Plans
description: A quick win: understand Anchoring with Annual Plans.

hook.text: Netflix shows $15.49/month or $186/year. But what if they showed it as $0.51/day? Different feeling.

buildup.text: Framing the price per day, month, or year dramatically changes willingness to pay for the same thing.

discovery.text: Annual plans anchor on the monthly equivalent: '$8/month billed annually' hides the $96 upfront commitment.

twist.text: Annual billing reduces churn by 30-50% because cancellation requires waiting for the billing cycle to end.

climax.text: Price anchoring and annual billing are the two most effective tools for subscription retention.

punchline.text: Per month sounds cheap. Per year locks you in. Framing is everything.

quiz.question: Why do annual plans reduce churn?
options: Cancellation requires waiting for the billing cycle
